none: PAS KENT-803E71: A contemporary copy of an early constantinian AE3 Nummus
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A highly worn and degraded copper-alloy contemporary copy of a 4th century roman nummus (AE3) of the early years of The House Constantine (317-330). Probable 'BEAT(A?) TRANQLITAS', Altar VOTIS reverse prototype, uncertain mintmark dating to the period c. AD 321-324 (Reece Period 16). Obverse: Helmeted bust right t. Legend: '[___ ]NVS [P AVG]'. Reverse: Altar VOTIS XX. Legend: Illegible.…
